title: Book a heavy vehicle inspection
summary: This page provides instructions on how to book an annual Heavy Vehicle Inspection Scheme (HVIS) inspection online.
intro:
The Heavy Vehicle Inspection Scheme (HVIS) is an annual roadworthiness inspection scheme. Most heavy vehicles need this annual HVIS inspection.

Your renewal notice will let you know what inspection(s) are required. The renewal notice will also give a date by which the inspection(s) must be completed to avoid having your registration suspended or cancelled.

You can book your HVIS inspection online up to 12 months in advance.

Note: Bus drivers are required to have their passenger compartment areas cleaned and sanitised prior to the HVIS inspection.
who_can_apply: The inspection is usually carried out as part of the registration renewal process.
The vehicle inspection can take place up to 3 months prior to the nominated renewal date.
The results of an inspection are valid for 3 months only.

how_to_steps.text: Enter the required details to complete your booking.

faqs.q: How far in advance can I book my HVIS inspection?
faqs.a: You can book your HVIS inspection online up to 12 months in advance.

faqs.q: When must I book the inspection?
faqs.a: Bookings must be made at least 24 hours prior to the inspection.

faqs.q: What is required for bus drivers before the HVIS inspection?
faqs.a: Bus drivers are required to have their passenger compartment areas cleaned and sanitised prior to the HVIS inspection.
